donts: Don't introduce new accent hues — deepen/lighten plum instead.
Don't place body copy on plum except inside the hero glass card.
Don't use square buttons, symmetric arches, or sharp cards; the system has no 0–8px radii.
Don't reuse lh3.googleusercontent hotlinks or CDN Tailwind v3 in production — replace with local assets and Tailwind v4 @theme on implement.
dos: Do use pill CTAs for every action (exact: 9999px, uppercase 12px).
Do keep body surfaces paper/white/blush; reserve plum for glass, gradients, and accents.
Do use the asymmetric arch pair only for the Why-Now photo moment (arch-top left, arch-bottom right).
Do keep eyebrows 12px uppercase orchid above every H2 that needs one.
Do keep header pills on their exact hexes (contact #862768→#721E57, call #6B1E53→#53133F) and the hero CTA on its exact gradient.
Do follow the section map order and line-range composition when rebuilding the page.
keyCharacteristics: Soft and reassuring, never stark or urgent
Pill buttons and arch photos as signature geometry
narrative.overview: A warm clinical sanctuary: deep plum authority softened by blush surfaces, pill CTAs, and arch photography. Single landing page that reassures first and explains second — every section resolves to booking. Density is airy (80px sections, max-w-7xl container); decoration is restrained to gradients, glass, and arches.

rules.name: The One Plum Rule
rules.body: Plum/accent ink covers ≤10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point; body surfaces stay paper/white/blush.

rules.name: The Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Section eyebrows are always 12px uppercase orchid; never body-color.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only on hover, glass-over-image, or elevated cards.

rules.name: The Asymmetric Arch Rule
rules.body: Arches are directional: arch-top left, arch-bottom right, never symmetric or swapped.

rules.name: The Exact Pill Rule
rules.body: Header pills and hero CTA keep exact hexes/gradient; never substitute family approximations.
